## Checklist for a new skill

- [ ] Directory name is a gerund, kebab-case, and matches the `name` in frontmatter.
- [ ] `description` is a routing rule in third person (what, plus when to use), under 1024 characters.
- [ ] `license: MIT` is set in the frontmatter.
- [ ] The body has a scope check that ends by telling the reader to stop if they cannot name the authorization.
- [ ] The method is tool-agnostic: it names the capability a step needs, not a product.
- [ ] There is a worked example with one confirmed finding and one killed lead.
- [ ] There is a "rationalizations to reject" section.
- [ ] Findings map onto the shared finding schema, and the schema is linked in Related.
- [ ] No em dashes or en dashes anywhere in the file.
- [ ] The skill is added as a row in the README table under the right lane.

## For a fix or edit

- [ ] The change is scoped and does not rename or restructure unrelated skills.
- [ ] I re-read the surrounding steps so the edit stays consistent with them.
